top_signals.title: Moubarak: GCC Economies Set for Strong Recovery in 2027
top_signals.summary: The US-Iran conflict continues to weigh heavily on economies around the world and in particular those in the Gulf. Ramona Moubarak, the MENA Country Risk Head for BMI, a Fitch Solutions Company, spoke to Bloomberg’s Jennifer Zabasajja on Horizons Middle East & Africa as the war enters its 8th month. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rupee Nears Record Low as RBI Hike Leaves Traders Wanting More
top_signals.summary: India’s rupee retreated even after the central bank hiked interest rates for the first time in four years, as the lack of more aggressive steps to tighten liquidity and support the currency left traders disappointed.

top_signals.title: Jaguar unveils $130,000 electric vehicle two years after controversial rebrand
top_signals.summary: The launch comes as luxury rivals Ferrari and Bentley also push into EVs, seeking to test wealthy buyer's appetite for going electric.
